<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>SnapFrame — Capture, Create & Share What You Love</title>
  <meta name="description" content="SnapFrame is a social media platform that makes it easy to capture, create, and share what you love with the people who matter most.">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@4.7.0/fonts/remixicon.css" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --color-black: #000000;
      --color-white: #ffffff;
      --color-purple: #7638FA;
      --color-orange: #FF7A00;
      --color-purple-light: #F3EEFD;
      --color-orange-light: #FFF4EB;
      --color-gray-50: #F9FAFB;
      --color-gray-100: #F3F4F6;
      --color-gray-200: #E5E7EB;
      --color-gray-300: #D1D5DB;
      --color-gray-400: #9CA3AF;
      --color-gray-500: #6B7280;
      --color-gray-600: #4B5563;
      --color-gray-700: #374151;
      --color-gray-800: #1F2937;
      --color-gray-900: #111827;
      --font-body: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --font-display: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      --transition: 0.2s ease;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      color: var(--color-gray-900);
      background: var(--color-white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    /* ========== HEADER ========== */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);

    .header-inner {

      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 64px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;

    .logo-icon {

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .header-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .header-nav a {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--color-gray-600);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .header-nav a:hover {
      color: var(--color-black);
    }

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--color-black);
      color: var(--color-white);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--color-gray-800);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--color-black);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--color-gray-200);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-gray-400);
    }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--color-black);
      font-size: 24px;
    }

    /* Mobile nav overlay */
    .mobile-nav {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 999;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 80px 32px 32px;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }

    .mobile-nav-close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 24px;
      color: var(--color-black);
    }

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 14px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-gray-100);
      color: var(--color-gray-900);
    }

    .mobile-nav .btn {
      margin-top: 24px;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    /* ========== HERO ========== */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      padding: 140px 24px 100px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #fff 0%, #faf5ff 40%, #fff8f0 100%);
    }

    .hero-bg-shapes {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-shape {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(80px);
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .hero-shape-1 {
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: var(--color-purple);
      top: -120px;
      right: -80px;
      opacity: 0.12;
    }

    .hero-shape-2 {
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: var(--color-orange);
      bottom: -80px;
      left: -60px;
      opacity: 0.1;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-content {
      max-width: 720px;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      color: var(--color-black);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 20px);
      color: var(--color-gray-600);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple), #9B5CF6);
      color: white;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: var(--transition);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(118,56,250,0.3);
    }

    .hero-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(118,56,250,0.4);
    }

    /* ========== SECTIONS COMMON ========== */
    .section {
      padding: 80px 24px;
    }

    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: var(--color-purple);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 36px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.2;
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      color: var(--color-black);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-desc {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--color-gray-600);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .section-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-purple);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .section-link:hover {
      gap: 10px;
      color: #5a1ee8;
    }

    .section-link i {
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    /* ========== FEATURES ========== */
    .features {
      background: var(--color-white);
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .features-visual {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple-light), var(--color-orange-light));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .features-visual-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 32px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 360px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .feature-card i {
      font-size: 28px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      display: block;
    }

    .feature-card:nth-child(1) i { color: var(--color-purple); }
    .feature-card:nth-child(2) i { color: var(--color-orange); }
    .feature-card:nth-child(3) i { color: #E11D48; }
    .feature-card:nth-child(4) i { color: #059669; }

    .feature-card span {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-gray-700);
    }

    /* ========== SAFETY ========== */
    .safety {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #F0FDF4 0%, #fff 100%);
    }

    .safety-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .safety-visual {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #DCFCE7, #D1FAE5);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .safety-visual-inner {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .safety-shield {
      width: 100px;
      height: 100px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .safety-shield i {
      font-size: 44px;
      color: #059669;
    }

    .safety-badges {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .safety-badge {
      background: white;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-gray-700);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

      gap: 48px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .creators-visual {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FAE8FF, #F5D0FE);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 32px;
    }

      height: 80px;

      background: white;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

    .news-header {

    function openMobileNav() {
      mobileNav.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeMobileNav() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', openMobileNav);
    mobileNavClose.addEventListener('click', closeMobileNav);
    mobileNavLinks.forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', closeMobileNav));

    // Close mobile nav on escape key
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && mobileNav.classList.contains('open')) {
        closeMobileNav();
      }
    });

    // Header scroll effect
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    let lastScroll = 0;

    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      const currentScroll = window.pageYOffset;
      if (currentScroll > 10) {
        header.style.boxShadow = '0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)';
      } else {
        header.style.boxShadow = 'none';
      }
      lastScroll = currentScroll;
    });

    // Smooth scroll for anchor links
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const targetId = this.getAttribute('href');
        if (targetId === '#') return;
        const target = document.querySelector(targetId);
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault();
          target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      });

The SnapFrame corporate About landing page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

## Completed Build

### Sections (in order per `task_input.json`):
1. **Header** — Fixed navbar with glassmorphism blur effect, logo, desktop nav links, "Log in" button, and hamburger icon for mobile
2. **Hero** — Bold gradient background with purple/orange blurred shapes, headline, value prop, and "Try it now" CTA
3. **Features** — Two-column layout with feature cards (Clips, Stories, DMs, Explore) and link
4. **Safety** — Green-tinted section with shield icon, trust badges, and description
5. **Creators** — Purple/pink gradient with creator avatars and aspirational copy
6. **Tagline Banner** — Full-width vibrant gradient with "Where everyday moments bring friends together"
7. **News Carousel** — Horizontally scrollable card list with `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory`, swipeable on mobile, scrollable on desktop. Each card has thumbnail, category tag pills, title, and date
8. **CTA Download** — "Create, share and connect. Download now." with App Store and Google Play buttons
9. **Footer** — Dense 6-column grid (About, Features, Safety, Community, External Links, Partner Links) plus bottom row with language selector, social icons, and legal links

### Key Interactions:
- **Hamburger menu** — Opens/closes mobile navigation overlay with smooth slide transition, Escape key support, and body scroll lock
- **News carousel** — Native horizontal scroll with snap points, hidden scrollbar, touch momentum on mobile
- **Smooth scroll** — Anchor links scroll smoothly to sections
- **Header shadow** — Appears on scroll for depth

### Design System:
- **Fonts**: Inter (body) + Plus Jakarta Sans (display)
- **Colors**: Black `#000000`, Purple `#7638FA`, Orange `#FF7A00` per brand spec
- **Icons**: RemixIcon via CDN
- **Responsive**: Breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, and 480px with hamburger menu, stacked grids, and adjusted typography
